_comment: Working notes for photo credits. Not shipped to the site. Each cover image (<id>-01.jpg) was put through Google Lens reverse image search (Exact matches) on 2026-11-17, by its public URL on thelexicon.xyz. 'traced' = where the original appears to have been published; it is NOT a credit. Only record a photo_credit after reading it on the source page itself (npm run credit). Never infer a photographer from a publisher.
method: Google Lens 'Exact matches' (udm=48) for https://thelexicon.xyz/public/THE-LEXICON-ASSETS/<id>/<id>-01.jpg. The original is taken to be the largest copy with the same 2:3 aspect ratio, dated to the show.
next_step_vogue: For entries traced to a Vogue Runway gallery: open the collection on vogue.com/fashion-shows, find this look, copy the 'Photo: …' line under it exactly, and run: npm run credit -- <id> "<credit as printed>" "Vogue Runway" <collection URL>

checked.note: Cover is one of the 18 images on this page. No per-photo credit printed; site footer reads "© The Impression LLC". image_source set; photographer still unknown — ask The Impression.
checked.resolved: 2026-11-22: all 12 images are Vogue Runway Miu Miu Spring 2022 looks (cover = look 1, distance 1); credit printed there: Filippo Fior / Gorunway.com.

miyake-ss99.evidence: 8 matches, all Instagram/Pinterest (largest 2000x2571). Captions date this photo to Issey Miyake FW 1994-95 or SS 1995
miyake-ss99.flag: Possibly the wrong season for an SS99 entry: check before crediting

season_conflict.finding: All 14 images match Vogue Runway Issey Miyake Spring 1995 ready-to-wear (dHash distance 0-5 each); none match Spring 1998, and Vogue has no Spring 1999 show. The entry is dated SS99: the photos are from SS95. Needs an editorial decision (re-date the entry, or replace the images).
